Name: AT - Mystical Mini-Obelisks
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[size=3]Content pack for Alternative Textures.
[b]
Note 1:[/b] As with all Alternative Texture packs, they only take effect for new placed items (unless you use the Paint Bucket).

[b]Note 2: [/b]You can use the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket tool[/url] from the Alternative Textures framework to change Mini-Obelisks into different textures.

[size=3][b]Note 3:[/b] I highly suggest using my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7900]Multiple Mini-Obelisks[/url] to allow for more than 2 Mini-Obelisks.[/size][/size]

Requires Alternative Textures.
